NewsArticle.Title: Temples Expanded
NewsArticle.Content:
All eight religions' sizes have more than doubled in the last month and are still growing fast. Mundanes have doubled the sizes of every shrine. They are, in fact, too large now to be called shrines. They are now temples to their god.
[Click here](http://www.darkages.com/2000/play/s_religion.html) to learn more about religions that you can participate in and receive miracles from. [Click here](http://www.darkages.com/2000/atavism/news) to see religious mass schedules and other events in Dark Ages.
